title: tscv-vision: Computer-vision feature engineering for 1D time series

creators.name: Ribeiro, Diogo
creators.affiliation: School of Media Arts and Design, Polytechnic of Porto, Portugal

description: tscv-vision is a NumPy-first Python package for computer-vision feature engineering of one-dimensional time series. It converts time-series signals into image representations such as Gramian Angular Fields, recurrence plots, and STFT spectrograms; extracts classical image descriptors including intensity statistics, histograms, gradient histograms, and local binary patterns; and supports sliding-window processing plus a command-line workflow for NumPy .npy files.
notes: The core package is designed to keep runtime dependencies minimal, with NumPy as the primary dependency and heavier integrations exposed through optional extras. Release archives are intended to support reproducible citation of the source code corresponding to each tagged version.
